guidance.procedure: Map actor, modality, action, object, trigger, condition, exception, quantifier and governing definition. Request-only disposition does not establish return at termination; retention permission does not establish disposition. An end-triggered duty covers it, while an all-copies/all-forms return-or-destroy duty opposes retention absent an express carve-out. Cite every operative split and independent repetition, including duplicated provisions, but not headings, recitals, certifications or nearby context. Independent development and third-party receipt require distinct permission or exclusion language; a development ban or third-party clause cannot substitute for the other. Nontechnical protected categories oppose technical-only; oral, any-form or intangible language supports oral coverage. Universal identification follows when protection is conditioned on marking or notice; under this annotation convention, preserving confidentiality legends on every authorized copy also counts, while optional marking does not. Nonemployee sharing requires operative permission; employee-only access plus a general third-party ban opposes it, as do consent-only permissions. Agreement confidentiality includes existence, terms, negotiations, identities and deal arrangements; narrow compelled-disclosure exceptions do not reverse the restriction. No-solicitation requires broad no-contact language or employee solicit, hire or induce restrictions; exclude customer and noncompete provisions. Ownership, reserved rights and no-license clauses support no-license; under this benchmark, a narrow evaluation license with reserved ownership does not negate it—cite grant, reservation and ownership. Copy permission needs an operative exception, including reproduction expressly allowed elsewhere; consent-only bans oppose. During-and-after duties, continuing obligations or retained copies remaining bound establish survival. Absolute design, development or manufacture use bans can support reverse-engineering.
